description: Android activity class 'CheckVoiceData' that checks for the presence of voice data files for specific languages, determines support status, and returns the results via intent extras.

classes.name: CheckVoiceData
classes.description: An Android activity that checks for voice data files for supported languages and reports their availability.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks voice data for specified or all supported languages, and sets the result.

methods.name: getCheckVoiceDataFor
methods.description: Retrieves list of languages to check from intent extras.

methods.name: isLanguageSupported
methods.description: Checks if a language is in the list of supported languages.

methods.name: isDataInstalled
methods.description: Checks if voice data file for a language exists in assets.
